entities.name: Rona
entities.description: Human artificer from Dominaria, follower of Gix and leader of the Society of Mishra, later compleated.

entities.name: Phyrexian Rona
entities.description: Rona after full compleation, her torso mounted atop a Phyrexian Obliterator's lower body.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: Ancient Thran rebel who became a Phyrexian Demon, Rona's inspiration.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: Phyrexian praetor found by Rona and restored.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: Defeated by Rona in a confrontation.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Planeswalker who rejoined Rona and spirited her away.

entities.name: Jodah
entities.description: Seriously wounded by Rona with her glaive.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: Praetor who ordered Rona sent to Jin-Gitaxias.

entities.name: Society of Mishra
entities.description: Group led by Rona pursuing forbidden Phyrexian lore.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Magical tradition in which Rona trained.

entities.name: Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
entities.description: Invasion staged by Sheoldred with Rona as second-in-command.

entities.name: Battle of the Mana Rig
entities.description: Battle after which Sheoldred named Rona head of operations.

entities.name: Urza's Tower
entities.description: Site of the Temporal Anchor, attacked by Rona.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: Plane where Rona's endoskeleton was brought.

events.summary: Rona leads clandestine excavations in the Caves of Koilos and discovers the charred but living Sheoldred.
events.quote: discovered the charred but still living form of the Phyrexian praetor Sheoldred

events.summary: Rona restores Sheoldred's flesh and becomes her second-in-command in the Second Phyrexian Invasion; she bests Karn and attacks Yavimaya.
events.quote: She bested Karn in a direct confrontation

events.summary: After the Battle of the Mana Rig, Sheoldred names Rona head of operations; the force regroups in Shiv's Cometia Crater.
events.quote: Sheoldred named Rona the new head of operations for the invasion.

events.summary: Rona and Tezzeret attack Urza's Tower; she seriously wounds Jodah but is wounded by Elspeth Tirel and spirited away by Tezzeret.
events.quote: she seriously wounded Jodah with her glaive

events.summary: Tezzeret brings Rona's endoskeleton to New Phyrexia; Elesh Norn sends her to Jin-Gitaxias, and she is compleated by the Etched Host.
events.quote: she was compleated by the black-aligned Etched Host

relations.quote: as the leader of the Society of Mishra
was her second-in-command in staging the Second Phyrexian Invasion of Dominaria
As an acolyte of Gix, Rona led a series of clandestine excavations
she was wounded by Elspeth Tirel in return
